classes.label: Tue Nov 3 · Start T-shirt Research
classes.bring: Your Brand Studio work and three relevant brand links.
classes.work: Connect competitor observations to two possible audiences and brand directions.
classes.review: Ask a classmate which observation supports your intended audience.
classes.update: Add the comparison, two short personas and your choice to the existing T-shirt record.
classes.note: Brand Studio keeps its own November 3, 11:59 p.m. deadline and original rubric.
classes.careerWin: Explain why a website serves a particular audience—useful evidence for a client conversation.

classes.label: Thu Nov 5 · Research workshop and teams
classes.bring: Your T-shirt research draft and two career descriptions to explore.
classes.work: Work on T-shirt Research, form teams, and launch career exploration as portfolio Research.
classes.review: Trade one specific research observation and question; respond in the project issue.
classes.update: Revise the T-shirt record. Keep career cards/reflection private; record team members.
classes.careerWin: Practice giving useful feedback and choosing career skills to build next.

classes.label: Tue Nov 10 · Start plans and group Research
classes.bring: Submitted T-shirt Research, draft career findings, and a group business idea.
classes.work: Begin T-shirt/portfolio plans. Discuss roles; begin the group comparison.
classes.review: Can someone explain your chosen reader and check a proposed user story?
classes.update: Continue each project record; use draft career findings without making a second portfolio Research report.
classes.careerWin: Turn research into a plan you can explain to a teammate or interviewer.

classes.label: Thu Nov 12 · Plan and research workshop
classes.bring: T-shirt/portfolio plan options, group Research, and private career reflection.
classes.work: Improve the two individual plans and the group audience choice.
classes.review: Swap roles: check a story and its success condition; discuss one career interest/gap.
classes.update: Update the same records and one continuing issue where relevant.
classes.careerWin: Show that you can improve an idea after another person questions it.

classes.label: Tue Nov 17 · Start individual builds and group Plan
classes.bring: Your three checkpoint records and the local T-shirt backend starter/setup.
classes.work: Build the two individual A/B approaches; turn group findings into a small spec and fair work split.
classes.review: Can a partner tell what passes and who owns/reviews each group task?
classes.update: Add current build links and actual contributions; plan SQLite as part of the T-shirt workflow.
classes.careerWin: Turn a small plan into a working feature and share responsibilities clearly.

classes.label: Thu Nov 19 · Build and group-plan workshop
classes.bring: Working individual versions, profile/résumé drafts, and the group Plan.
classes.work: Try A/B, improve links and stories, and integrate small changes early.
classes.review: A peer tries the same task in both versions without coaching; group partners cross-review.
classes.update: Link observations, changes and checks. Distinguish public preview from local SQLite.
classes.careerWin: Show a working interaction, a real check, and a useful response to feedback.

classes.label: Tue Nov 24 · Improve individuals; start group Build
classes.bring: Individual A/B builds and the shared group Plan.
classes.work: Choose individual launch directions; start the group build. Review final improvement expectations now.
classes.review: Check résumé/profile/repository links and actual contributions; group partners test each other’s slice.
classes.update: Mark the portfolio group case study in progress. Record current work separately from planned work.
classes.note: No class Thursday November 26. November 30–December 3 is work/review/catch-up time with no new topic.
classes.careerWin: Make a launch decision and explain what you built, checked, and still need to finish.

classes.label: Tue Dec 1 · Protected work and reviews
classes.bring: All three working projects, one task per review, and open issues.
classes.work: Finish individual walkthroughs and fixes; test and integrate the group workflow.
classes.review: A real peer tries the task; capture a meaningful obstacle and the change/retest.
classes.update: Update existing records with evidence, limits and each member’s actual work.
classes.careerWin: Finish a reliable workflow you can demonstrate without coaching the visitor.

classes.label: Thu Dec 3 · Submit checkpoints; finish and rehearse
classes.bring: Individual final-review records and the group A/B build.
classes.work: Finish group walkthroughs, changes/retests, missed reviews and demo rehearsal.
classes.review: Verify final links and professional materials; both partners explain their own work.
classes.update: Keep the same individual URLs current through December 6; final assessments reuse existing links, with no second individual upload.
classes.note: Group Improve and all final sites/links are ready Sunday December 6 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern.
classes.careerWin: Practice a short demonstration that makes your own contribution clear.

classes.label: Tue Dec 8 · Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned demo slot, portfolio, both projects and working links.
classes.work: Present if scheduled; support classmates and give useful feedback.
classes.review: Explain one decision, your actual contribution and a verified improvement.
classes.update: Keep the same published URLs; note any instructor-requested fixes.
classes.note: Follow your confirmed slot. Pairs use 10 minutes; trios use 12.
classes.careerWin: Use finished work to explain your choices and contribution to a professional audience.

classes.label: Thu Dec 10 · Demo Day
classes.bring: Your assigned demo slot, portfolio, both projects and working links.
classes.work: Present if scheduled; support classmates and give useful feedback.
classes.review: Show actual evidence and clearly state unfinished work.
classes.update: Keep the same published URLs; follow Canvas for any remaining instructor directions.
classes.note: The December 22 overflow/redo arrangement remains in the Demo Days guide.
classes.careerWin: Show useful work and make a clear professional introduction.
